module_management_regression.scope: Unified contextual menu covered before final numeric-header wrapping-only CSS correction; original binary hashes retained.

limits: Theme grouping changes presentation only, not map IDs or definition order.
Removed definitions are retained in UI-session memory up to 128 entries; persistent custom libraries use presets.
Draft selection/transfer is distinct from Apply; no arbitrary source/calibration defaults are fabricated.
Measured 25px rows/14px font and header fit apply to tested Chrome/Windows viewport, not arbitrary OS scaling.
No physical, low-end resource, long-duration, power-loss or macOS acceptance.
